description: Content SHA-256 of each parser version on the recorded EDGAR documents (tests/fixtures/edgar/lumentum). Pinned when the version was created; a changed hash means a new parser version is needed. text-v2 keeps html-text-v1's HTML rules, so its hashes are the same. text-v3 removes page artifacts from paginated HTML: the 10-Q (lite-20260328.htm) and the 10-K (lite-20260627.htm) lose their page numbers and "Table of Contents" back-links, so their hashes change; the 8-K and the EX-99.1 have page breaks but no artifacts, so theirs don't.
